title: Iran Blockade Sets Up a Test of Which Side Can Endure More Pain
partialText: President Trump is trying to choke off the country’s lifeline with a blockade of the Strait of Hormuz. But the Iranians are betting that his tolerance for political pain is limited.

title: Trump Said Other Countries Would Help Blockade Iran. So Far, There Are No Takers.
partialText: President Trump’s announcement of a complete U.S. blockade was his latest effort to pressure Iran to negotiate after direct talks over the weekend did not yield an agreement.

title: Israelis Don’t Feel Much Like Victors in War With Iran

title: After Criticizing Pope, Trump Posts Image of Himself as a Jesus-Like Figure

title: How Orban Lost His Touch, and Hungary’s Election

title: Orban Loss May Ease Hungary’s Tensions with European Union
partialText: Prime Minister Viktor Orban has stymied the European Union for years, and particularly in recent months. Peter Magyar’s election could change that.

title: Hungary May No Longer Be Putin’s Ally, but It Can’t Afford a Full Break
partialText: Prime Minister Viktor Orban’s defeat will make it harder for the Kremlin to divide Europe, but Moscow retains leverage through energy sales.

title: 4 Takeaways From Orban’s Defeat in Hungary’s Election
partialText: Economics and unhappiness with endemic corruption helped Peter Magyar, the challenger, secure victory. A visit by the U.S. vice president in support of Mr. Orban didn’t change things.
